title: Improve Launch tab command-state clarity
summary: Improve Launch tab responsiveness, preflight confidence, command-state clarity, and readiness status semantics without adding frontend mutation authority.
reason: The Launch tab audit found stale backend-preflight coupling, ambiguous CSV rerun preview/live evidence, vague Start Pipeline blocked reasons, misleading compact review controls, missing dangerous-control state transitions, duplicate-prone audit actions, and incomplete status coloring.
behavior_before: Launch form changes could trigger backend preflight fanout, CSV rerun preview and execution shared preflight identity, Start Pipeline explained blocks generically, compact gates looked like load controls, and several dangerous/audit controls lacked clear confirming or in-flight states.
behavior_after: Launch local form changes update immediately while marking cached backend preflight stale, CSV rerun preview/live requests are distinct, Start Pipeline shows the exact gate/action, compact gates read as review selectors, and dangerous/audit controls visibly confirm, run, cancel, or block duplicates.
manual_validation: npm run webview:lint - passed with 0 errors and existing warnings
rollback_plan: Revert the Launch WebView static asset, Launch partial, targeted WebView smoke, generated-summary, and this change-packet updates.
notes:
WebView Launch display/state and no-mutation smoke validation only. Do not launch processing, mutate queue/source/output/scratch state, save settings, drain pending publish, publish, rename, or run real media.
Validation used temporary local API/browser smokes only; no pipeline/audit/rerun/drain/publish/rename/settings-save/media processing commands were run.
Strict change coverage passed after recording this Launch change packet.
